messages:
Joni: Quick heads-up 1: calibration sample freeze moved earlier this cycle to 48h before close (was 24h). Reason: large late-file drop in last round skewed buckets.

Ravi: Who approved that change? We need to warn managers earlier so they don't rely on late handbacks being in calibration.

Maya: Approved by People Ops + Eng Leadership. We announced in the all-hands but agreed we need channel-level reminders. Will post a banner in the console too.

Priya: How do we treat flagged exceptions? Example: a peer submitted high-quality feedback after the freeze but before close. Can that be included in calibration?

ops-bot: Exception workflow: managers may submit a "calibration-include" request for up to 3 items per team within 12h post-freeze. Request triggers manual review by People Ops. Use the UI button or endpoint: https://redwoodinference.internal/peopleops/calibration-exceptions

Ravi: Is there an audit trail for those manual inclusions? Need to capture rationale for audits.

Maya: Yes 1: every exception entry is logged with manager comment, reviewer id, feedback id, and a short reason. We retain logs for 3 years.

Joni: We also had a problem where redistributions changed the distribution of seniority in buckets. Any guardrails for that?

ops-bot: Redistribution rule v3: maintain seniority parity within calibration buckets when possible. If parity cannot be preserved, system annotates the affected buckets and flags for manual review.

Priya: Practical question: managers often want to mark reviewers as "soft-exempt" (e.g., heavy project week) without doing a formal LOA. Is there a lightweight flag that prevents reassignment but keeps them in calibration pools?

Maya: Introducing "soft-exempt" for this cycle: managers can set a 72h soft-exempt which prevents auto-reassign but does NOT remove items from calibration. Use the reviewer inline menu in the console or `/set-soft-exempt @handle 72h`.

Ravi: Nice. Will that show up in the reviewer roster export? We use that CSV for external dashboards.

Maya: Yes 1: new column `soft_exempt_until` added to roster CSV.

Joni: Another ask: can we get a nightly digest of calibration-sample changes (freeze, exceptions, reassignments) so product managers can track drift?

ops-bot: Digest scheduled: nightly at 04:00 UTC to `#people-ops` and sends a compact CSV attachment. To subscribe for team-level digests DM `@ops-bot subscribe calibration <team-name>`.

Priya: One more 1: what happens if a manager submits an exception after we've already run calibration analytics? Will metrics be recomputed?

Maya: We don't automatically recompute historical analytics. Exceptions included post-run will be appended to the calibration audit but will not retroactively change the KPI numbers used in manager communications. If you need recompute for a formal appeal, file a ticket with justification and we'll run a targeted recompute.

Ravi: Ops question: if a reviewer is soft-exempt and then gets manually reassigned by a lead, does the soft-exempt get revoked?

ops-bot: Manual reassignment takes precedence and will clear `soft_exempt` for the affected feedback items only. Reviewer-level `soft_exempt_until` remains until expiry.

Joni: Thanks 1: can you add a short FAQ blurb we can share with managers? Maybe a 3-bullet checklist: when to request exception, how to set soft-exempt, and where redistributions are logged.

Maya: Will do. Draft FAQ link: https://redwoodinference.internal/peopleops/calibration-faq (publishing today).

Priya: tagging @Maya for the FAQ review. Also volunteers for the weekend coverage rota? I can take a Sunday morning slot.

Maya: Thanks @Priya! Adding you to the rota. If anyone else can volunteer, add to: https://tiny.redwood/feedback-weekend-rota

ops-bot: Note: calibration freeze policy updated in the handbook 1: /handbook/performance#calibration-freeze. A notification email will go to all managers at 09:00 PT today.
